text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Brilliantly overcoming a field of fierce rivals!
The one crowned Queen of the Cherry Blossoms is—Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Hanshin Racecourse is trembling with cheers of celebration!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That is the first crown...!
It is an honor to bring it home to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—As for Craft...
Her closing speed was truly ferocious, as expected.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Her next race, the Yushun Himba (Oaks)—or perhaps
even beyond that. She will surely stand in our way."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Maintaining the status quo will see us overtaken in no time.
Let us devise a strategy and establish a clear direction."
choice_data_list: Yeah...! Let's do our best in the next Oaks, too!
Yeah...! Let's do our best at the next one, the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No... with my Trainer, and with my rivals.
I was just thinking how truly blessed I am.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: W-W-Whoa...! Cesario-san and Craft-san, too...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That was quite something, the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I really should have gone to see it in person! What a missed opportunity...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I agree――
Especially her――Cesario's race."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Her technique is, of courseâ
An overwhelming... fighting spirit. An obsession with "victory"â

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Truly—an extraordinary talent.
—A one-in-a-million talent.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm, I totally get it! What amazing potential~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... If it's her, perhaps—
To the point where I couldn't help wishing so.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wish... you say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yes—
A revolution—in the Japanese Umamusume world...
In other words—the power—to take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I found myself dreaming of such a wish...
With Cesario...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Selfish expectations.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
............
Hehe, no, it's great, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Entrusting our dreams and hopes to the active members.
That is our important job right now♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The stars of this year's "Oka Sho"
are Rhein Kraft and Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With such memories etched in mind,
the spring stage drew to a close.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho was really fun.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: That was amazing! Cesario, Heart-san, Messiah-san... everyone!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Alright...! I've decided!
No more looking back!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I have to go... toward my own path...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next target race is the Yushun Himba (Oaks)—
the crown of the Queen of the Oaks that she has desired most of all.
